neighbours.label: the open back IPA vowels ɑ and ɒ in dictionary pronunciations
fire: IPA: /ˈkɑɹdən/ is the usual American form.
The noun is written [mah-lah] /ˈmɑ lɑ/ in the guide.
British speakers say /ˈhɒspɪtl/ for that word.
The word has the sound /ɑ/ in its first syllable.
Most dictionaries give /ˈkɒfi/ for this drink.
In Boston it is /ˈpɑːk/ with no final r.
We hear /dɒg/ in the south of England.
quiet: IPA: /ˈkiːtən/ is the usual American form.
The noun is written [mee-lee] /ˈmi li/ in the guide.
British speakers say /ˈsɪtɪ/ for that word.
The word has the sound /i/ in its first syllable.
Most dictionaries give /ˈtiː/ for this drink.
In Boston it is /ˈsiː/ with a long vowel.
We hear /pɪn/ in the south of England.
